card.name: Linking words after a completed action
card.fires_on: Small linking words (by, at, over, from, using, as, with) right after a past-tense or passive clause about who made something, where, or how. Mostly in encyclopedic history or procedure text.

modes.label: Agent or place of creation
modes.description: By, at or from after a passive verb about building, casting or translating something.
modes.example: was completely translated to Persian<< by>> a Mughal courtier, Abdul

modes.label: Method or duration
modes.description: Using or over after a described action, giving the technique or time span.
modes.example: Aseptically reconstitute each Kyprolis vial only with Sterile Water for Injection, USP<< using>> the volumes described in Table 6.

card.plain: It fires on little linking words like by, at or using that come after a finished action and introduce who, where or how.
